title: Edge Network Capacity Upgrade
purpose: Expand edge network capacity to support increasing API traffic and add a third regional point of presence.
expectedImpact: Brief connection resets for in-flight long-poll requests. API retries handled automatically by SDKs.

updates.author: Danilo Okafor, SRE
updates.details: Maintenance started. Traffic shifted to the two existing POPs.

updates.author: Danilo Okafor, SRE
updates.details: Maintenance completed on time. New POP serving traffic; error rates and latency within normal range.

completionSummary: Third regional point of presence added with zero downtime. P95 API latency improved by 12% across regions.
